behavior: bucket_start_ms = floor(timestamp_ms / width_ms) * width_ms using mathematical floor division (Python //); timestamp_ms=-1, width_ms=1000 gives -1000 Ordering: Output ascending by sensor_id then bucket_start_ms. Every input record is aggregated, including duplicate keys; count, sum, min and max are exact integers.

outputs.rows: list[tuple[str, int, int, int, int, int]] as (sensor_id, bucket_start_ms, count, sum_milli, min_milli, max_milli)
